demo.program:
# Papua New Guinea — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of Papua New Guinea?", "Port Moresby"),
    ("What currency does Papua New Guinea use?", "Kina"),
    ("What is capital?", "Port Moresby"),
    ("What is currency?", "Kina (PGK)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+675"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".pg"),
    ("What is driving side?", "left"),
    ("What is continent?", "Oceania"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
